messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
It depends on what you’re looking for:

| Context | Top Assist Provider | Season / Career |
|---------|---------------------|-----------------|
| **All‑time Premier League record** | **Ryan Giggs** | 162 assists (1992–2014) |
| **Most recent full season (2023/24)** | **Kevin De Bruyne** (Manchester City) | 12 assists (2023/24) |

If you meant the current season’s leader, Kevin De Bruyne tops the charts with 12 assists so far. If you were asking about the historical record, Ryan Giggs holds the Premier League all‑time assist record with 162 assists.
